title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.0.9
description:
• 🛠️ Fixed UI Launch Bug: Resolved ComboBox dependency initialization on fresh start.
• 👤 Male & Female Profile Selection: Choose between Random (Mixed), Male Only, or Female Only names & gender with 350+ realistic Facebook-friendly names.
• 🔄 Guaranteed SMS Resend: Automatically triggers 'Send SMS Again' / 'Resend Code' on Facebook to guarantee immediate OTP delivery.
• ⚡ Ultra-Fast 1.0s OTP Polling: Instant OTP inspection as soon as API link opens, with high-frequency 1.0s refresh intervals.
• 🛡️ Hardcoded Apify Live UID Verification: Apify engine verifies active vs suspended profiles with zero false positives.
